mechanism_claims.claim_text: TAT-Kα2 acts at pre-attachment or attachment when peptide and virus are in contact before or during cell exposure; post-attachment treatment did not show the same inhibition.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports virucidal timing/pre-attachment action, not a host-target binding mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TAT-Kα2 directly destabilizes viral particles/envelopes, shifting sedimentation behavior, reducing infectivity of collected fractions, and producing collapsed lipid-bilayer morphology by TEM.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports envelope destabilization; proposed barrel-stave/carpet-like details remain hypothetical and are not promoted as established direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The activity pattern is envelope-associated: Table 2 reports IC50 values for enveloped viruses and No for the two non-enveloped viruses tested.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Specific lipid-binding molecular structure was not solved in this paper.

non_promoted_claims.claim: precise barrel-stave or carpet-like membrane mechanism
autophagy as the antiviral mechanism in this study
